ranking_rationale: What separated the top from the bottom was the handling of the direction-versus-magnitude gap: hgf and case_memory both saw clear upward pressure, said plainly which quantity they could not obtain (the GASDESW monthly change and the median of four prior changes), and mapped a below-threshold central to the option that contains it, while structured_reasoning and principle_memory converted the same qualitative language into a confident claim that a 4.16 percent monthly move would occur. Below them, direct_forecast and structure_memory carry no mechanism and no citations at all, and three traces (factor_memory, direct_forecast, structure_memory) state one prediction in their reasoning block and the opposite in their forecast block.
shared_evidence_note: The banks were not the source of the split: both E0 and E1 pointed upward on diesel, and the E1 pair diverged from each other in narrative while agreeing on 'no', so the disagreement came from whether each trace treated directional evidence as sufficient to assert a 4.16 percent threshold crossing rather than from what it read.
